name: costas_array_n16__v1_nh
prompt:
Find a Costas array of order 16: place 16 marks on an 16x16 grid, one per row and one per column, such that all 16*(15)/2 displacement vectors (dr, dc) between pairs of marks (with dc > 0) are pairwise distinct.

Return x as a list of 16 integers in 0..15, where x[c] is the row of the mark in column c (permutation), or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such array exists.
